limitations: Only a two-job integration check, not a speed comparison or final-film acceptance.
Full motion, audio listening and seam review remain required.
Test prompt incorrectly locates lamp on screen left while the supplied storyboard shows it on screen right; final prompts need visual consistency correction.
Six-frame seam review shows a small pose/framing change; native-state prefix equality does not prove a visually seamless cut between separately decoded clips.

seamMetrics.metric: mean absolute RGB difference at 432x240, 0-255 scale
seamMetrics.interpretation: Frame difference alone is not perceptual proof; visible pose/composition change at the seam requires review and investigation.
